title: eludite.tools.options input
description: Tools > Options: open the Options dialog, generated from the settings schema (protocol/schemas/settings.json) and grouped by its sections. Each change in the dialog runs eludite.settings.set. Agents read and change settings with eludite.settings.get and eludite.settings.set instead.

section.description: The page to show, for example `Projects and Solutions > Build and Run`, or `NuGet Package Manager > Package Sources` (the sources from the NuGet.config chain, edited through eludite.nuget.sources; Tools > NuGet Package Manager > Package Sources...). Omitted: the first page.
